title: Preview scenario v1 (P1 static capture)
description: Closed input, at most 1 MiB. P1 implements only settle and capture with the wall-static profile. Known later operations are rejected before mount with E_UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY; unknown operations and malformed supported payloads are E_SCHEMA. Step IDs and capture IDs are unique in their respective namespaces, checked by the loader. Explicit capabilities are unioned with all inferred requirements: capture requires pixels, a virtual profile or requiredFrameTimeUs requires virtual-time. Wall mode rejects virtual-time even if explicitly advertised by a caller.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities must be available before mount. Repeated declarations are deduplicated; omission never bypasses inferred requirements. P1 advertises pixels only.

safeId.description: One safe path component matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*; no separators, traversal components, whitespace or encoding escapes. The absolute end assertion also rejects a trailing newline.

timeoutMs.description: Optional lower real per-step budget, in milliseconds. If present it must be a positive JSON integer literal, not null. The driver rejects values above profile.limits.maxStepWallMs; this option cannot raise a profile limit or add a sleep.

requiredFrameTimeUs.description: Optional exact virtual validation-frame timestamp. A present value must be a nonnegative JSON integer literal, not null. Infers virtual-time and is unavailable with wall-static/P1; it must never be silently ignored.
